definitions.explanation: A feeling of not being satisfied or pleased with something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不満|ふまん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{不満|ふまん}そうな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They have a dissatisfied look on their face.

notes:
{不満|ふまん} functions as both a na-adjective and a noun. It is formed by adding the negative prefix {不|ふ} to {満足|まんぞく} (satisfaction).

FORMS:
- {不満|ふまん}な + noun: {不満|ふまん}な{表情|ひょうじょう} (dissatisfied expression)
- 〜に{不満|ふまん}がある: to have complaints about ~
- {不満|ふまん}を{言|い}う: to voice complaints
- 〜に{不満|ふまん}だ: to be dissatisfied with ~
- {不満|ふまん}を{持|も}つ: to harbor dissatisfaction

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不満|ふまん}そうな{顔|かお}: a dissatisfied-looking face
- {不満|ふまん}が{溜|た}まる: frustration builds up
- {不満|ふまん}を{漏|も}らす: to let dissatisfaction slip out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不満|ふまん}: general dissatisfaction (broad)
- {不平|ふへい}: grievance, complaint (often paired: {不平|ふへい}{不満|ふまん})
- {苦情|くじょう}: formal complaint (to a company, authority)
